purpose: Make every future evidence observation replayable from a source-reported observation through extraction, derivation, digitization and unit-normalization steps without promoting any current candidate to authoritative biological reference status.

DIRECT_REPORTED_VALUE.meaning: The numerical estimate and uncertainty are explicitly reported by the source; no numeric derivation or figure digitization is used.

DERIVED_VALUE.meaning: The normalized estimate is mathematically derived from identified reported inputs.

FIGURE_DIGITIZATION.meaning: A numeric value is extracted from a figure rather than directly reported as a number.

double_extraction_policy.goal: Detect evidence-ingestion disagreement, not claim independent biological replication.
double_extraction_policy.independence_requirement: extractor_id values must differ and extraction processes must be separately performed; the repository does not claim independence merely by duplicating one extraction.
double_extraction_policy.match_result: EXTRACTION_MATCH; authoritative admission remains blocked until v0.6.
double_extraction_policy.conflict_result: EXTRACTION_CONFLICT_PRESERVED; do not average; authoritative admission blocked.

current_real_source_replay.source_locator: Results > Delivery of SCFAs into the colon of healthy subjects > paragraph immediately before Figure 2; Figure 2B

claim_ceiling: v0.5 validates extraction lineage and replayability mechanics only.
No current candidate becomes an authoritative human reference observation.
No human dose, formulation, safety, efficacy, clinical target or food recommendation is established.
A matching double extraction is not independent biological replication.
A future v0.6 admission decision must remain context-specific and must not collapse observations into one universal biological vector.
next_gate: v0.6 may consider authoritative reference-set admission only after at least one observation has complete source lineage, exact citation location, extraction replay, uncertainty semantics, and a genuinely separate second extraction with no unresolved conflict.
